name: Blockman Engine Dev
postCreateCommand: bash .devcontainer/setup.sh 2>&1 | tee /tmp/setup.log; echo 'SETUP_EXIT='$? >> /tmp/setup.log; bash .devcontainer/auto_build.sh 2>&1 | tee /tmp/autobuild.log; echo 'AUTOBUILD_EXIT='$? >> /tmp/autobuild.log; cp /tmp/setup.log /tmp/autobuild.log .devcontainer/ 2>/dev/null; git add .devcontainer/setup.log .devcontainer/autobuild.log 2>/dev/null; git -c user.name=Codespace -c user.email=cs@noreply.github.com commit -m 'Build logs' 2>/dev/null; git push origin main 2>/dev/null; true
